description: Buddy Phase 19 — Production Hardening & Orchestration. Phases 1-18 built 67 modules. Gap analysis reveals 22 are initialized but never called, unbounded memory growth in watch mode, no agent lifecycle management, no orchestrator health checks, 97 unused observations, and no replay validation. Phase 19 focuses on making the system production-ready: memory management, module activation, agent lifecycle, health monitoring, observation consumption, and historical replay. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Memory manager with LRU cache and log rotation
userStories.description: Create a MemoryManager that prevents unbounded growth in watch mode.
acceptanceCriteria: register_cache(name, cache_dict, max_size) registers a dict for LRU eviction
evict_lru() removes oldest entries when cache exceeds max_size
rotate_log(path, max_lines, archive_dir) rotates large log files
get_memory_report() returns RSS, cache sizes, and pressure score
userStories.notes: Implemented memory_manager.py with MemoryManager. ManagedCache wrapper with LRU eviction via access order tracking. Log rotation: archive old lines, keep recent N. RSS monitoring from /proc/self/status with resource module fallback. RSS_WARNING_MB=500, RSS_CRITICAL_MB=1000. Default rotation: max 10K lines, keep 5K. Archive to trained_data/archive/. Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Module activation map and async dispatch
userStories.description: Create a ModuleActivationMap that tracks which modules are initialized, called, and orphaned.
acceptanceCriteria: register_module(name, instance, run_every_n_cycles) registers a module with cycle frequency
should_run(name, current_cycle) returns True if module should execute this cycle
get_activation_report() returns list of all modules with status (active/orphaned/disabled)
get_dependency_graph() returns dict mapping module → dependencies
userStories.notes: Implemented module_activation.py with ModuleActivationMap. ModuleRecord tracks per-module state (runs, skips, errors, status). Configurable run_every_n_cycles for async dispatch. Dependency-aware topological sort in get_modules_to_run(). Auto-detects orphaned modules (initialized but 0 runs after 5 cycles). complete_cycle() logs activation snapshots every 10 cycles. Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Agent lifecycle manager with fitness tracking and quarantine
userStories.description: Create an AgentLifecycleManager that tracks real-time agent fitness and manages quarantine/promotion.
acceptanceCriteria: update_fitness(agent, won, regime) tracks rolling accuracy per agent
get_weight_modifier(agent) returns multiplier based on status
quarantine_agent(agent) sets agent to quarantined with 0.3x weight
promote_candidate(agent) transitions candidate → active after threshold trades
userStories.notes: Implemented agent_lifecycle.py with AgentLifecycleManager. 4 status levels: ACTIVE (1.0x), QUARANTINED (0.30x), CANDIDATE (0.50x), RETIRED (0.0x). Quarantine at <35% accuracy, recovery at >50%, retirement at <25% in quarantine. Candidate promotion at >60% after 30 trades. AgentRecord tracks outcomes, transitions, and fitness. Automatic status evaluation on every update. Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Orchestrator health registry and pre/post-cycle validation
userStories.description: Create an OrchestratorHealthRegistry that provides collective health monitoring for all modules.
acceptanceCriteria: register_module(name, health_check_fn) registers a module with its health check
run_preflight() runs all health checks, returns pass/fail per module
run_postflight() validates modules persisted state successfully
should_continue_cycle(min_health) returns True if health above threshold
userStories.notes: Implemented health_registry.py with HealthRegistry. ModuleHealth tracks per-module check results, consecutive failures, pass rates. Critical modules (engine, agents, execution, etc.) weighted 2x in health score. Auto-disable after 3 consecutive failures (non-critical only). MIN_HEALTH_TO_CONTINUE=0.40. Graceful degradation: disabled modules don't block. Preflight/postflight separation. Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Observation consumer with pattern detection and alerts
userStories.description: Create an ObservationConsumer that analyzes 97+ observations from observation_log.py.
acceptanceCriteria: detect_patterns() returns recurring patterns with frequency and confidence
recommend_adjustments() returns config change suggestions based on patterns
check_alerts(window_hours) returns alerts for category spikes
userStories.notes: Implemented observation_consumer.py with ObservationConsumer. Reads observations.jsonl, categorizes by type/pair/regime. Pattern detection at 3 levels: type, pair-specific, regime-specific. 5 recommendation mappings (near_miss → lower threshold, agent_disagreement → increase uncertainty weight, etc.). Spike alerting: 5+ occurrences in time window = warning, 10+ = critical. Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.

userStories.title: Historical replay validator with drift detection
userStories.description: Create a ReplayValidator that runs current scan logic against historical data.
acceptanceCriteria: replay_scan(pair, historical_candles, scan_config) runs scan on historical data
compute_would_be_pnl(replay_results) returns simulated P/L, Sharpe, max drawdown
detect_drift(recent_replay, baseline_accuracy) returns drift_score and alert flag
compare_configs(config_a, config_b, historical_data) returns A/B performance comparison
userStories.notes: Implemented replay_validator.py with ReplayValidator. ReplayResult container with total_pnl, win_rate, sharpe, max_drawdown. Simplified signal simulator (momentum-based) for offline replay. ATR computation from candle data. SL/TP simulation walking forward through future candles. Drift detection: 10% accuracy drop from baseline = alert. A/B config comparison with weighted scoring (Sharpe 40%, win_rate 30%, PnL 30%). Config flag added, wired into engine.py init. py_compile passes.
